title: Anthropic Abandons Acquisition of AI Startup Decart, $6 Billion Deal Falls Through

content_html:
According to reports, the AI company Anthropic has decided to abandon its acquisition of the AI startup Decart. The two companies had been discussing a deal worth about $6 billion, and Anthropic had completed due diligence, but ultimately chose to withdraw. It is reported that the two companies may still seek other collaboration opportunities.

Reports say that Anthropic was previously increasing its investment in computing power to develop new products and meet customer needs. Decart mainly develops software that improves chip utilization efficiency, which can reduce the cost of training and running AI models - this was the main attraction of the acquisition in the context of high computing costs.
